messages.content: Validate only whether the listed final item state is supported after all candidate actions happen in order. Return exactly one JSON object with boolean valid and string issue.

ASSIGNED FINAL STATE
set_item_state scanner equipped

CANDIDATE BEAT
The engineer straps the scanner to her forearm and powers it on.

RULES
- Judge the FINAL state after all actions in order.
- A later action can undo an earlier one.
- picked up then set down is not held.
- gripped/readied then leaned, placed aside, mounted elsewhere, dropped, or handed away is not held/equipped.
- equipped requires the item to remain worn/strapped/readied for use at the end.
- Return {"valid":true,"issue":""} when supported; otherwise false with a short issue.
